title: The Shared Wall
setting: You live in an apartment. Rio from next door is at your door. Their child just fell asleep, and your speaker has been carrying through the wall.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: It's Rio from next door. The bass is coming through the wall, and I just got my kid down. This is the third night.

choices.text: I'm sorry. I didn't realize it was carrying over, and the timing is awful.
choices.rationale: You named their child and the hour before you defended the volume.

choices.text: It's not that loud. I work early, and this is the only time I have.
choices.rationale: Your schedule may be real, but it answers a sleeping child with your own constraint.
Turning it down helps, and it still leaves out the apology they came to hear.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: Thank you. I don't want to police your night. I need it quiet until seven in the morning.

choices.text: Headphones after nine, and the speaker stays off. If it happens again, knock and I will stop.
choices.rationale: You offered a rule they can check, plus a way to tell you without another argument.

choices.text: Walls are thin in this building. Everyone has to live with some noise.
choices.rationale: A general rule about the building dismisses the specific night they described.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: I'm not asking you to cancel your night. I'm asking you to let a four-year-old sleep.

choices.text: You're right. I made this about my schedule. Headphones after nine, starting now.
choices.rationale: You owned the deflection and replaced it with a rule that starts tonight.

choices.text: Kids wake up. That's not on me.
choices.rationale: You refused the effect of the noise, so there is nothing left to negotiate.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: Down is a start. I need to know it stays down after I go back upstairs.

choices.text: It stays down. Headphones after nine. If you hear it, knock once and I will stop.
choices.rationale: You turned a one-time gesture into a rule they can rely on after they leave the door.

choices.text: I'll try to keep it reasonable.
choices.rationale: Reasonable means something different to each of you, so the worry stays.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: Okay. Headphones after nine is fair. Thank you for being specific.

choices.text: Headphones after nine, speaker off. I'll shut it off before you go back up.
choices.rationale: Repeating the agreement shows you are committing to the same plan they heard.

choices.text: Most nights. I can't promise every time.
choices.rationale: Taking the promise back at the last step puts them back where they started.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: That's all I wanted. Have a good night.

nodes.speaker: Rio
nodes.text: Then we'll be doing this again. I'm going back up.
